reason: The first source accepted a unified-v2 record even when additional v1 membership records were present. A v2-only headroom reader could then miss a legacy memory controller. Require exactly one /proc/self/cgroup line, which must be the single valid unified-v2 record; refuse hybrid/unknown layouts without fallback.

replacements.old:
need(len(groups) == 1 and groups[0].startswith("/") and
         all(part not in (".", "..") for part in groups[0].split("/")),
         "Standard unified cgroup v2 membership required; no fallback")
replacements.new:
need(len(group_lines) == 1 and len(groups) == 1 and groups[0].startswith("/") and
         all(part not in (".", "..") for part in groups[0].split("/")),
         "Single unified cgroup v2 membership required; hybrid layouts refused")

root_review_boundary: Root read the full original source before this narrow source-only revision. Revised source and full exact command still require root review and explicit admission.

primary_source.basis: Controller constraints are hierarchical; v1 and v2 may coexist; memory.high is a throttle/reclaim boundary, memory.max a hard limit. This proposal refuses hybrid membership and uses the minimum of visible max/high headroom conservatively.
